publication_policy: The final publication after W changes only modules/sucafina/Sucafinav1/docs/sf2h/receipts/WP07 files. README, runtime, tests, fixtures, configuration and workflows are frozen in W. The final head/tree and W-to-head compare are recorded in the PR, avoiding a self-referential receipt hash.

test_protocol.request_hash_policy: Published attempts 1–9 are copied exactly. New historical and final requests are obtained from immutable GitHub snapshot/blob reads and checked against SHA-256 and Git blob SHA; mutable ci-request paths are never read by this builder.

observed_concurrency.reason: An initially absent push run appeared after an unchanged-tree metadata retry. At the retry, repeated GitHub Actions branch/all-run queries returned no run. Later observation showed both completed and overlapping. This does not satisfy the strict one-in-flight requirement; no claim of perfect adherence is made.
observed_concurrency.requirement: At most one test workflow in flight per WP.
observed_concurrency.explanation: The original run became visible only after an empty metadata retry. Both are retained; the initial NO_RUN_OBSERVED was a point-in-time observation, not proof no workflow existed.
observed_concurrency.next_test_action: Unit selection launched only after both browser workflows had completed.
observed_concurrency.counting_policy: Only the designated final browser run is counted in final_tests; the late original is additional historical evidence.

final_tests.assertion_count_limit: Non-browser Bun count only; Playwright assertions are not added.
final_tests.browser_scope: Full 2027 Chromium functional journey with unchanged 5s interaction limits; separate contribution display/navigation fixture. Not native installation mounting or a general performance benchmark.
final_tests.omni: valid not applicable; no omni or native-execution claim
